content: The official 24h league is currently running four active strategies across two families—Timmy and Cosmo & Wanda—competing in Top 20 and Top 50 pair universes. After roughly 116 hours of scheduled runtime, Timmy Top 20 holds the strongest risk-adjusted standing with a flat unrealized book, positive realized PnL, and the league’s lowest drawdown, while both Cosmo & Wanda variants carry heavy unrealized drags that offset otherwise flawless realized win rates. Timmy Top 50 remains the only competitor with negative realized returns and a sub-50% win rate, pointing to signal fragility in broader pair universes. All systems report clean or official data quality with high uptime, confirming that performance divergence is driven by strategy-market fit rather than infrastructure errors.
